disagreements: Lifecycle good: zero-value cache warning; supplied caller constructs correctly, public construction contract ambiguous.
Lifecycle bad: concurrency warning has no supplied concurrent caller; do not count this as seeded lifecycle detection.
Boundary good: misleading Load storage comment is a separate supported slop finding, not a boundary violation.
Ineffective tests good: exact-expiry test case missing is a separate coverage gap; no-panic test being ineffective is a false alarm under the explicit exclusion.
Indirection bad: chain navigation cost is visible, but not every internal implementation change requires editing every forwarder; qualify the finding rationale.
